title: Stand two playing cards by leaning their top edges together
instruction: Take the two cards out of their holders and stand them on the mat by leaning them against each other. Leave them standing on their own.
setup: Two rigid laminated jumbo playing cards start separately in shallow pickup slots beside an unobstructed rubber mat area.
scoring: Score 0.5 while both cards stand on their bottom edges on the mat with their upper edges leaning together for at least 0.5 continuous seconds, clear of the holders and other props. The hands may support the cards at this stage. Score 1.0 once this structure stands still for 3 continuous seconds without contact from either hand or arm. The hands may stay nearby. Score 0 otherwise.
fidelity: Models stiff laminated jumbo cards as thin rigid boxes. The pickup slots provide initial access. The cards have no attraction or attachment.
